note: Replace YOUR_PUBLIC_N8N_DOMAIN with the HTTPS URL that reaches your self-hosted n8n (for example a stable Cloudflare Tunnel domain). This file is Vapi tool configuration/reference, not an n8n workflow import.

function.name: search_doctors
function.description: Search the clinic doctor directory by doctor name, specialization, branch, or gender. Use before availability when the doctor has not been uniquely identified.

doctor_name.description: Doctor name as spoken by the caller; empty string if not specified.

specialization.description: Requested specialization such as Cardiology or Dermatology; empty string if not specified.

branch.description: Clinic branch if caller specified one; otherwise empty string.

gender.description: Doctor gender preference only if caller explicitly requested it; otherwise empty string.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check live free appointment slots for one resolved doctor on one exact date in Pakistan time. Returns exact HH:MM slots, closures, doctor off status, and next scheduled date when available.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Create an appointment after doctor, date, time, and patient name are known. It validates schedule, minimum notice, 10-minute grid or doctor-specific slot size, and re-checks calendar conflicts.

phone.description: Use empty string to let n8n use Vapi caller ID. Supply only when booking should use another number.

reason.description: Optional short administrative reason; empty string if not needed.

function.name: lookup_appointment
function.description: Find the caller's active upcoming appointment(s), optionally filtered by date or doctor. Use before cancel/reschedule when details are unclear.

phone.description: Empty string uses Vapi caller ID.

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Move an existing appointment to a new valid date/time. Prefer appointment_id from lookup when available.

appointment_id.description: Internal appointment id from lookup; empty string if unavailable.

doctor_name.description: Doctor name; empty string if appointment_id uniquely identifies it.

phone.description: Empty string uses Vapi caller ID.

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancel one confirmed appointment after the caller has confirmed cancellation. Prefer appointment_id from lookup when available.

appointment_id.description: Internal appointment id from lookup; empty string if unavailable.

phone.description: Empty string uses Vapi caller ID.

function.name: answer_question
function.description: Answer factual clinic administrative questions from the clinic FAQ data. Never use for medical diagnosis or treatment advice.

question.description: Caller's question, kept close to their own wording.

function.name: request_callback
function.description: Create a callback request when the receptionist cannot safely or reliably complete the caller's request.

name.description: Caller/patient name if known, otherwise empty string.

phone.description: Empty string uses Vapi caller ID.
